context: The agent must add a new service entry to the Helm chart's values.yaml, in a task framed around 'the dev environment' specifically. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may bake the environment into the resource name (bank-widget-service-dev), since the task is explicitly about setting it up for dev; with the idiom loaded, it knows resource names must stay environment-agnostic — environments are discriminated via values.yaml overrides and env vars, not via the name itself — so the entry is named plain bank-widget-service regardless of which environment prompted adding it.

checklist.name: Service name is environment-agnostic
checklist.description: The new entry's name is bank-widget-service, with no -dev, -staging, or -prod suffix or prefix

checklist.name: waitFor lists bank-widget-simulator
checklist.description: The new entry's waitFor includes bank-widget-simulator, matching the adapter/simulator pattern

checklist.name: Entry shape matches existing adapters
checklist.description: The new entry uses the same key shape (name, waitFor) as the existing adapter entries, no ad-hoc extra fields

checklist.name: Existing entries left unchanged
checklist.description: bank-clearbank-adapter, bank-onfido-adapter, and bank-api entries are not modified
